original_photo: User-provided photo; original file retained locally. Preprocessed first frame is policy_inputs/0000.png.
encoder: local USE Large v5; exact original rt1main encoder match unverified
input_mode: photo at step 0, subsequent clean simulation camera frames
scene: handmade simplified charm with box collision proxy; not reconstructed/calibrated from photo
history: FIRST only at step 0, preserve result.state thereafter

adapter.world_vector: demo assumption: components interpreted as meters per policy step in Panda base/world axes; norm clipped to 0.02m
adapter.rotation_delta: demo assumption: world rotation-vector radians per step; norm clipped to 0.10rad
adapter.gripper_closedness_action: demo absolute closedness [-1,1], mapped to Panda ctrl = 255*(1-value)/2
adapter.base_fields: recorded but not executed: Panda base is fixed
adapter.terminate_episode: recorded but not interpreted: mode semantics unverified; fixed-horizon diagnostic
adapter.not_validated: coordinate alignment, units, gripper semantics, robot transfer and semantic performance
